desc:
👋 Welcome to 🐱 Troll Cat Tower!

🐈 Use your leash to grab other players
💀 Drag them wherever you want
🚀 Then LAUNCH them across the tower
😂 Troll everyone with chaotic moves!

🔥 Can you survive the tower without getting flung?
🏆 Reach the top and prove your skills!
😈 Or send everyone else flying first?

🎮 CONTROLS (PC):
Throw: X
Pull: E
Leash: M1

⭐ Enjoying the game? Don’t forget to 👍 LIKE, ⭐ FAVORITE, and SHARE with friends!
